# route_demo — thread ranks fixture

A a private production codebase-shaped Next.js route, shrunk to the node shapes the thread-rank
view folds (src/shared/thread_rank.ts): a guard that logs and returns, a
rate-limit helper with no boundary, local string work, logging, and a
constructed OpenAI client whose method is the one round trip. Pinned by
`npm run test:thread-rank` (through the real pipeline) and
`npm run test:e2e-thread-rank` (in the renderer).
